gpu_launcher_source:
"""gpu-node launcher: run benchmarks/suites/benchmark_layerwise_mcts_qwen15b.py on the A100.

pkg/gen_zero/causal holds byte-identical copies of the repo modules (sha256 in the report);
the two package __init__.py files are empty so only these modules load.
"""
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path[:0] = [os.path.join(HERE, "pkg"), HERE]
import benchmark_layerwise_mcts_qwen15b as suite  # noqa: E402

MODEL = r"D:\hf_cache\hub\models--Qwen--Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct\snapshots\989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306"
sys.exit(suite.main([
    "--hf-model", MODEL, "--data", os.path.join(HERE, "boolq.jsonl"),
    "--device", "cuda", "--dtype", "float32", "--n", "100", "--folds", "5",
    "--label", "NVIDIA A100 full 100-row 5-fold",
    "--out", os.path.join(HERE, "layerwise_mcts_qwen15b_report_gpu.json"),
]))
cpu_command: env PYTHONPATH=python /home/luy/.venv-gz-torch/bin/python benchmarks/suites/benchmark_layerwise_mcts_qwen15b.py --device cpu --threads 8 --eval-folds "[0]" --ffn-grid "" --label "dev CPU cached sparse hook rerun" --out /tmp/b1018c_cpu_rerun.json  (REMOTE_DONE rc=0)
caveats: GPU n=100 paired accuracy and CPU n=20 fold-0 accuracy are unchanged from the prior run; no accuracy effect is statistically significant at n=100.

The sparse hook is constructed once per runner and reused across predictions; one-time hook construction is measured separately by the operator microbenchmark and is excluded from per-row inference timing.
GPU sparse versus dense inference is 62.80 versus 63.13 ms/row; CPU fold-0 is 1122.22 versus 1150.84 ms/row. These small differences are single-run timing observations, not proof of a stable speedup.
GPU and CPU e2e per-row timing includes chat template, tokenizer, transfer, and predict; model load and fitting are excluded and reported separately.
CPU timing is one run on a shared host with load averages changing from 16.5 to 8.8; compare inference timing cautiously.
The suite uses the production VerbalizerProbe directly; its call transfers CPU residuals to the norm device on the A100.
